episodes.156296: Convection associated with a slowly southward moving frontal boundary draped across the south/central Florida peninsula produces a strong marine wind gust.
episodes.157011: Scattered thunderstorms moved from the mainland to the Atlantic along the Treasure Coast around mid day. One storm produced strong wind gusts along the coast in Indian River Shores.
episodes.157160: A quasi-stationary boundary remained draped for several days across the Lake Okeechobee region, allowing for ample moisture to remain pooled across the area. Showers and thunderstorms developed as multiple shortwaves traversed the area aloft. Several of these storms produced gusty winds as they moved offshore into the Atlantic and Biscayne Bay waters.
